approved_scenarios.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: draft scenario illustration for n³ Hearingpedia, a Chinese hearing science encyclopedia, adult university readership.
Style/medium: sophisticated editorial illustration, restrained semi-flat shapes, subtly textured paper and soft dimensional shading, graceful believable adult proportions, clear visual storytelling. Consistent subdued lavender purple (#6952b4), blue-grey and pale warm neutrals on almost-white background (#f8f9fc). Not childish. Landscape 3:2 composition, generous breathing room, no frame.
Constraints: Absolutely no lettering, words, numbers, speech bubbles, logos, captions or watermarks. No anatomical cutaways, no scientific graphs, no decorative equations. Sound marks if requested are tiny schematic visual metaphors, not physical wavefronts or measurement. Human hands and interactions must be anatomically plausible.
Primary request: A single everyday cafe scene explaining auditory masking: foreground two adult East Asian friends sitting across a small table, one speaking naturally with a small hand gesture, the listener attentive but mildly having difficulty catching the words. Background a barista actively operating an espresso grinder, and a distant table with two people talking, both clearly separate sources of competing sound. A few restrained lavender short strokes next to the speaker's mouth and muted grey strokes next to grinder and background conversation indicate concurrent sound sources; all terminate near their sources, no arrows. Keep foreground friends dominant and background subdued but legible. Show sound competition through context and modest listening gesture, not distress or a medical condition. Focus is background sounds making target speech harder to hear. No diagrams inside the image.

Primary request: A paired-scene illustration showing that successful understanding can require different amounts of listening effort. Two equally sized adjacent scenes with a small clean whitespace gap, no dividing line. Same two adult East Asian friends, same clothing and same table composition in both scenes, no text or labels. In one scene they have an engaged relaxed conversation in a quiet nearly empty dining room; listener comfortably nods, speaker gestures. In the other scene their conversation continues in a busy restaurant, clearly visible nearby adults talking and normal dining activity in background; the same listener still positively nods to indicate following the conversation but leans slightly toward the speaker, brow gently focused, posture attentive, hands naturally at table. Speaker gesture is similar. The listener is not sad, exhausted, sweating, clutching head or ears, or confused; depict active mental engagement not fatigue. No brain icons, batteries, gauges, numbers, thought bubbles, exaggerated pain, or claims of measured effort. Use environmental activity and the subtle listening posture contrast to communicate the concept. Both subjects equally prominent and recognizably identical across the two scenes.

Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: everyday scenario illustration for the Chinese hearing-science encyclopedia n³ Hearingpedia, "spatial hearing" article.
Primary request: Illustrate someone using sound direction to find a ringing phone in a living room. A young East Asian adult man in a muted lavender shirt sits in an armchair reading an open book. His torso and knees are oriented toward the front of the room; hearing a ringtone, he turns his head partway toward a phone on a low sideboard clearly located several feet behind and to one side of his chair. Composition is a clear three-quarter view with the chair and reader large in the foreground and the sideboard and phone clearly separated in the background. The phone lies naturally on the sideboard, visible as a small rectangular smartphone with a subtle lit screen. Only three tiny lavender curved strokes immediately next to the phone indicate ringtone activity. The reader has an attentive natural expression, no worry or frustration. His head turns toward the source without requiring him to see the screen; the book remains in both hands. The central teaching idea is "where did that sound come from?" Show one person, one phone, one source of sound, and a clear spatial relationship.
Style/medium: refined editorial illustration with soft realistic drawing and subtle painterly paper texture, graceful believable adult proportions. Restrained almost-white, pale warm neutral, blue-grey and lavender (#6952b4) palette to match the existing cafe and restaurant educational illustrations. Soft daylight in a calm uncluttered contemporary living room. Landscape 3:2, generous breathing room.
Constraints: No bike, no cyclist. No letters, words, numbers, speech bubbles, thought bubbles, labels, logos, watermarks, scientific graphs, anatomical cutaways, arrows, radiating beams or wavefront diagram. No extra people or sound sources. Ringing marks are symbolic strokes localized at the phone and are not physics. Both hands must naturally support the book; no extra fingers. The phone must rest on furniture, not float. Prioritize understandable everyday spatial arrangement over decorative scenery.

Panoramic, soft pastel anime-style illustration of a bustling modern train platform beneath an arched glass-and-steel roof, blending cool violet-blue shadows with warm sunlight, polished-floor reflections, distant city buildings, and infographic-like colored sound waves. A curious young woman in a lavender sweater and backpack watches a white high-speed train marked “广州南 → 深圳北 / 即将进站,” while chatting commuters, boarding passengers, a rolling suitcase, overhead announcement speaker, station clock and “7” sign, and a seated cellist with an open case animate the scene; labels identify companion conversation, train noise, music, luggage wheels, and the announcement, with “n³ Hearingpedia / OpenAI ImageGen” at bottom right.

Restrained lavender and blue-grey 3:2 horizontal composition, with small lower-right n³ Hearingpedia / OpenAI ImageGen attribution.

A middle-aged woman turns toward family members talking while she is at a bookshelf; an older man and younger woman converse near a sofa, with a television, plants and a resting dog in the background. Educational depiction of the distinction between noticing speech and understanding its content. Landscape 3:2 (1536 × 1024). Two-line lower-right n³ Hearingpedia / OpenAI ImageGen attribution. watermark_edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the provided illustration. Make exactly one localized addition: a small readable two-line attribution watermark in the lower-right corner. Text (verbatim), line 1: "n³ Hearingpedia"; line 2: "OpenAI ImageGen". The superscript 3 in n³ must be rendered correctly. Use clean sans-serif lettering, right aligned, dark muted lavender (#514268). Line 1 slightly larger than line 2. Both lines must fit in one subtle semi-transparent warm-white backing patch with rounded corners, approximately no more than 28% of canvas width and 8% of canvas height, inset about 24–30 px from the right and bottom edges. Small elegant attribution, not a logo or headline. It must remain clearly legible over the illustration.
Invariants: preserve the exact source illustration, all people, faces, gestures, furniture, objects, symbolic sound marks, framing, scene lighting, colors, canvas aspect ratio and full scene composition. Do not crop, zoom, repaint or redesign the scene. Do not add any other labels, signatures, borders or text. Change only pixels required for the watermark patch in the lower-right corner.
